description: Bike-Sharing Trip Data: Eight European Cities, 2024–2025 is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Sorath Shah (Masaryk University). Bike-Sharing Trip Data: Eight European Cities, 2024–2025 (Master Dataset) Derived trip-level bike-sharing dataset for Brno, Ostrava, Opava, Frýdek-Místek, Havířov (Czechia, Aug–Oct 2024), Frankfurt am Main (Germany, Jan–Mar 2025), and Badalona and León (Spain, Apr–May 2025). Coverage: several countries (CZ, DE, ES); the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
